value_stream.name: Global Mobility, Immigration & Foreign Worker Compliance

fields.Participants: HR (VS-19), hiring manager, Legal (VS-100.3), DOLE Regional Office, immigration agent (W4700)
fields.Trigger: New foreign hire; AEP expiry (annual/biennial); role change
fields.Volume: ~15–25 active foreign workers needing AEP across the 5 entities (seconded experts per VS-122, executives)

workflows.name: DOLE Alien Employment Permit (AEP) Application & Renewal Operations

Automation Opportunity: - AEP-application document assembly; renewal-alert automation; justification-evidence library
Controls: - CTL-711: AEP justification documented; no work before AEP; renewals before expiry (compliance calendar)
Cross-references: - links to W4700 (agents), W4703 (calendar), W4706 (9G/I-Card), W4711 (audit), VS-123 (local talent)
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-justification risk**: DOLE may deny the AEP if BuildRight cannot justify the absence of a qualified Filipino (developed via VS-123); mitigated by robust justification and local-talent-development evidence
- **Pre-AEP-work risk**: A foreign worker starting before AEP issuance → DOLE penalty; mitigated by the no-work-before-AEP rule
System Touchpoints: - Immigration/case management; compliance calendar (W4703); HR (VS-19); records (VS-88)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Prepare and file the DOLE AEP application: proof of the foreign worker's qualifications, the justification for hiring a foreign national (no available qualified Filipino — DOLE requirement), the position, and the employer's documents; engage the DOLE Regional Office (via immigration agent W4700)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: Track the AEP issuance and conditions (validity, role/entity scope); file renewals before expiry per the compliance calendar (W4703); manage AEP conditions (role/entity changes require amendment)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Retain AEP records (VS-88); support DOLE inspection/audit (W4711) and ensure the foreign worker does not commence productive work before AEP issuance (compliance)

fields.Participants: HR (VS-19), Legal (VS-100.3), BI, immigration agent (W4700), foreign worker
fields.Volume: ~15–25 active 9G visa holders (the W4705 AEP population)

workflows.name: Bureau of Immigration 9G Pre-Arranged Employee Visa & ACR I-Card Processing

Automation Opportunity: - Visa/I-Card application document assembly; expiry-alert automation; entry/exit tracking
Controls: - CTL-711 (ensure controlled execution — Immigration, Visa & Foreign-Worker Compliance Operations (PA-160.2).)
- CTL-711: 9G/I-Card secured before productive work; renewals before expiry; no overstay (compliance calendar)
Cross-references: - links to W4705 (AEP), W4703 (calendar), W4711 (audit), W4718 (exit-clearing), VS-88 (records)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overstay risk**: Visa/I-Card expiry unnoticed → overstay (BI fines, blacklist, deportation); mitigated by the compliance calendar + alerts (W4703)
- **Wrong-status-work risk**: A tourist/9a visa holder doing productive work → immigration violation; mitigated by the 9G-before-work rule
System Touchpoints: - Immigration/case management; compliance calendar (W4703); HR (VS-19); records (VS-88)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: On AEP issuance (W4705), file the BI 9G Pre-Arranged Employee Commercial Visa and ACR I-Card application (with the employment contract, AEP, and supporting documents); manage the foreign worker's entry/visa status (downgrading/conversion from tourist/9a where applicable)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: Track visa/I-Card validity, conditions, and entry/exit; file renewals before expiry (W4703); manage exit-clearing (Emigration Clearance Certificate / SSDC where applicable) on assignment end (W4718)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Retain visa/I-Card records (VS-88); support BI audit (W4711); ensure no overstay (BI penalty, deportation, officer liability)

fields.Participants: HR (VS-19), Legal (VS-100.3), Tax (VS-79), hiring manager, BI
fields.Volume: ~5–10 cases/year (short-term experts, treaty-based assignees, CAI commercial-arrangement cases)

workflows.name: Special Work Permit (SWP), Treaty-Trader (9D) & Other Visa Category Selection

Automation Opportunity: - Category-decision tool with tax/immigration implications; document assembly per category
Controls: - CTL-711: category-selection rationale documented; category fits actual engagement; tax-treatment aligned (W4714)
Cross-references: - links to W4714 (tax), W4703 (calendar), W4711 (audit), VS-79/VS-100.3 (tax/legal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Category-mismatch risk**: Choosing a category that doesn't fit the actual engagement (e.g., SWP for long-term work) → violation; mitigated by the category-selection framework
- **Tax-treatment-mismatch risk**: Visa category and tax treatment misaligned → tax exposure (W4714); mitigated by Tax involvement in selection
System Touchpoints: - Immigration/case management; tax (VS-79); compliance calendar (W4703); records (VS-88)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Select the appropriate immigration category for each case: Special Work Permit (SWP) for short-term specialized work (<6 months); Treaty-Trader/Investor (9D) where a qualifying treaty/business exists; 9G for standard employment; Special Visa for Employment Generation (SVEG) where applicable

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: File and track the chosen category with its specific documents, conditions, and tax implications (category affects residency/tax treatment W4714); manage transitions between categories

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Document the category-selection rationale (avoid category-shopping that misrepresents the engagement); retain records (VS-88); support audit (W4711)

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing (VS-122), Legal (VS-100.3), Tax (VS-79/VS-17.2), HR (VS-19), home-country employer
fields.Trigger: Sourcing agent/seconded expert need (VS-122); intra-group transferee

Automation Opportunity: - Secondment-agreement templates; immigration+TP+contract workflow; lifecycle tracking
Controls: - CTL-711 (ensure controlled execution — Immigration, Visa & Foreign-Worker Compliance Operations (PA-160.2).)
- CTL-711: secondment legally/tax-structured (VS-100.3/VS-17.2); immigration status continuous; records retained
Cross-references: - links to VS-122 (global sourcing), VS-17.2 (TP), VS-72 (intercompany), VS-98 (contingent distinction), W4705/W4706 (AEP/9G)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Secondment-structure risk**: A secondment that masks an employment/co-employment relationship (VS-98) or TP issue (VS-17.2); mitigated by Legal/Tax structuring
- **Status-during-transition risk**: Immigration gap during secondment transition; mitigated by proactive status management
System Touchpoints: - Immigration/case; contracts (VS-100.3); TP (VS-17.2 W612/W1299); HR (VS-19); records (VS-88)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal / VP Supply Chain
steps.activity: For sourcing agents/secondees (VS-122) and intra-company transferees, structure the immigration (AEP W4705 + 9G/I-Card W4706 or SWP) and the secondment/transfer agreement (home employer, host entity VS-72, duration, cost allocation)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / CFO
steps.activity: Manage transfer-pricing/cost-allocation of the secondment (home-country cost + markup, per VS-17.2 TP) and the immigration status during secondment; coordinate with home-country employer

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: Retain secondment/transfer and immigration records (VS-88); manage secondment extension, conversion to localization (W4718), or return

workflows.name: Foreign Executive, Director & Board-Officer Visa & SEC-Related Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - Director-appointment + immigration workflow; residency/tax determination tool
Controls: - CTL-711: foreign-director appointment SEC/governance-aligned (VS-36); residency/tax determined (VS-79); renewals managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (governance/board), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-79 (tax), VS-102 (comp)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Foreign-ownership/sector risk**: A foreign director where sectoral foreign-ownership limits apply → SEC issue; mitigated by Legal/Corp-Secretary check
- **Director-residency-tax risk**: Mis-determined director residency → tax exposure (VS-79); mitigated by Tax determination
System Touchpoints: - Corporate governance (VS-36); immigration/case; tax (VS-79); comp (VS-102); records (VS-88)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal / Board
steps.activity: For a foreign executive/director/board-officer, secure the appropriate immigration status (often 9G or 47A(2) for government-owned/controlled or special-status, or treaty-based) and ensure alignment with SEC/corporate-governance appointment (VS-36)

steps.a: VP Legal / CFO
steps.activity: Manage the director's residency/tax status (resident vs. non-resident director), per-diem/compensation structuring (VS-102), and SEC-related foreign-ownership/sector restrictions where applicable

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Retain records (VS-88); manage renewals and exit; ensure board-meeting attendance (in-person or via the foreign director's valid status) doesn't breach immigration rules

fields.Participants: HR (VS-19), relocation vendor (W4700), schooling, Employee Accommodation (VS-144), OH (VS-83)

workflows.name: Dependent & Family Visa, Schooling & Relocation Support

Automation Opportunity: - Dependent-visa workflow; relocation/settling-in checklist; PII access controls
Controls: - CTL-711 (ensure controlled execution — Immigration, Visa & Foreign-Worker Compliance Operations (PA-160.2).)
- CTL-711: dependent visas secured; family adjustment supported; dependent PII protected (VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to W4698 (assignment types), VS-144 (accommodation), VS-83 (OH), VS-91 (privacy), W4718 (assignment end)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Family-adjustment-failure risk**: Family maladjustment is a top assignee-return cause; mitigated by relocation/settling-in support
- **Dependent-PII risk**: Dependent (esp. children) PII is highly sensitive; mitigated by VS-91 governance

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: Secure dependent visas (9G-dependent/I-Card) for accompanying family; manage family relocation (entry, housing VS-144, schooling enrollment support, settling-in)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: Support dependent adjustment (schooling, healthcare VS-83, spousal-support info, community) — a key assignment-success factor (W4701); manage dependent visa renewals with the principal's

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility
steps.activity: Manage dependent visa status on assignment end (W4718) and retain records (VS-88); ensure dependent data is PII-governed (VS-91)

fields.Participants: Compliance (VS-22), Legal (VS-100.3), HR (VS-19), Internal Audit (VS-21), BI, DOLE

workflows.name: Immigration Document, Expiry & Compliance Tracking (BI/DOLE Audits)

Automation Opportunity: - Document register with expiry-alerts; audit-evidence binder; findings-tracking
Controls: - CTL-711 (ensure controlled execution — Immigration, Visa & Foreign-Worker Compliance Operations (PA-160.2).)
- CTL-711: document register with alerts; audit-ready; findings managed to closure; records retained
Cross-references: - links to W4703 (calendar), W4705/W4706 (AEP/9G), VS-22/VS-21 (compliance/audit), VS-88 (records)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overstay/lapse risk**: (as W4706) mitigated by the register + alerts
- **Audit-unpreparedness risk**: A BI/DOLE audit finding documents missing → penalty; mitigated by the register and audit-readiness
System Touchpoints: - Immigration/case; compliance calendar (W4703); HR (VS-19); records (VS-88); audit (VS-21)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Maintain the immigration-document register (AEP, 9G visa, I-Card, SWP, dependent visas) with expiry dates, conditions, and renewal triggers; alert before expiry (compliance calendar W4703)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Prepare for and support BI/DOLE inspection/audit: produce the required documents (alien registry, AEP/visa/I-Card records, employment contracts, justifications); manage findings

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Manage compliance events (overstay, late renewal, finding) to resolution; retain records (VS-88) for 7+ years; assure via Internal Audit (VS-21)

fields.Owner: Head of Global Mobility / Comp & Benefits
fields.Participants: Comp (VS-102), Payroll (VS-19.2), Legal (VS-100.3), Labor Relations (VS-84), DOLE
fields.Trigger: Foreign-worker hire; wage review; DOLE audit

Automation Opportunity: - Wage-parity check at payroll setup; statutory-benefit automation; displacement-justification library
Controls: - CTL-711 (ensure controlled execution — Immigration, Visa & Foreign-Worker Compliance Operations (PA-160.2).)
- CTL-711: foreign workers paid ≥ minimum wage with full statutory benefits; anti-discrimination applied; AEP justification robust
Cross-references: - links to VS-102 (comp), VS-19.2 (payroll), VS-84 (labor relations), W4705 (AEP justification), VS-123 (local talent)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sub-minimum-wage risk**: A foreign worker paid below minimum/without statutory benefits → DOLE violation; mitigated by the wage-parity rule
- **Displacement concern risk**: DOLE/labor concern about foreign-worker displacement of nationals; mitigated by robust AEP justification (W4705) and local-talent development (VS-123)
System Touchpoints: - Comp (VS-102); payroll (VS-19.2); HR (VS-19); labor relations (VS-84); records (VS-88)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / CHRO
steps.activity: Ensure foreign workers receive at least the applicable Philippine regional minimum wage and statutory benefits (SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG, 13th-month, leave) per DOLE — foreign workers enjoy the same labor protections; structure compensation per VS-102

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / VP Legal
steps.activity: Apply anti-discrimination and equal-treatment principles; manage any DOLE concern about foreign-worker displacement of Filipino labor (the AEP justification W4705 addresses this); coordinate with Labor Relations (VS-84)

steps.a: Head of Global Mobility / CHRO
steps.activity: Retain compensation records (VS-88); support DOLE wage/labor audit; assure via Internal Audit (VS-21)
